Pokedex.Name: Bulbasaur
Pokedex.Description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

Pokedex.Name: Ivysaur
Pokedex.Description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

Pokedex.Name: Venusaur
Pokedex.Description: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Venusaur
Pokedex.Description: In battle, this Pokémon swings around two thick vines. If these vines slammed into a 10-story building, they could easily topple it.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Venusaur
Pokedex.Description: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

Pokedex.Name: Charmander
Pokedex.Description: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

Pokedex.Name: Charmeleon
Pokedex.Description: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

Pokedex.Name: Charizard
Pokedex.Description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Charizard
Pokedex.Description: This colossal, flame-winged figure of a Charizard was brought about by Gigantamax energy.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Charizard X
Pokedex.Description: Other forms may have other colors.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Charizard Y
Pokedex.Description: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

Pokedex.Name: Squirtle
Pokedex.Description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Wartortle
Pokedex.Description: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

Pokedex.Name: Blastoise
Pokedex.Description: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Blastoise
Pokedex.Description: It's not very good at precision shooting. When attacking, it just fires its 31 cannons over and over and over.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Blastoise
Pokedex.Description: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

Pokedex.Name: Caterpie
Pokedex.Description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

Pokedex.Name: Metapod
Pokedex.Description: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

Pokedex.Name: Butterfree
Pokedex.Description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Butterfree
Pokedex.Description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

Pokedex.Name: Weedle
Pokedex.Description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

Pokedex.Name: Kakuna
Pokedex.Description: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

Pokedex.Name: Beedrill
Pokedex.Description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Beedrill
Pokedex.Description: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

Pokedex.Name: Pidgey
Pokedex.Description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

Pokedex.Name: Pidgeotto
Pokedex.Description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

Pokedex.Name: Pidgeot
Pokedex.Description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Pidgeot
Pokedex.Description: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

Pokedex.Name: Rattata
Pokedex.Description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Rattata
Pokedex.Description: With their strong capacity for survival, they can live in dirty places without concern. Left unchecked, their numbers multiply rapidly.

Pokedex.Name: Raticate
Pokedex.Description: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Raticate
Pokedex.Description: Its disposition is far more violent than its looks would suggest. Don’t let your hand get too close to its face, as it could bite your hand clean off.

Pokedex.Name: Spearow
Pokedex.Description: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

Pokedex.Name: Fearow
Pokedex.Description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

Pokedex.Name: Ekans
Pokedex.Description: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

Pokedex.Name: Arbok
Pokedex.Description: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

Pokedex.Name: Pikachu
Pokedex.Description: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Pikachu
Pokedex.Description: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

Pokedex.Name: Raichu
Pokedex.Description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Raichu
Pokedex.Description: It becomes aggressive when it has electricity stored up. At such times, even its Trainer has to take care to avoid being attacked.

Pokedex.Name: Sandshrew
Pokedex.Description: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Sandshrew
Pokedex.Description: It usually makes its home in deserts and arid zones, where rain does not fall. It digs holes to catch Bug-type Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Sandslash
Pokedex.Description: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Sandslash
Pokedex.Description: It uses its claws to climb trees and then curls its body into a spiny ball, ready to drop onto any prey that appears.

Pokedex.Name: Nidoran♀
Pokedex.Description: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

Pokedex.Name: Nidorina
Pokedex.Description: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

Pokedex.Name: Nidoqueen
Pokedex.Description: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

Pokedex.Name: Nidoran♂
Pokedex.Description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

Pokedex.Name: Nidorino
Pokedex.Description: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

Pokedex.Name: Nidoking
Pokedex.Description: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

Pokedex.Name: Clefairy
Pokedex.Description: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

Pokedex.Name: Clefable
Pokedex.Description: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

Pokedex.Name: Vulpix
Pokedex.Description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Vulpix
Pokedex.Description: From its mouth spew flames that seem to resemble the spirits of the deceased. Some people mistakenly think this fire is a ghost.

Pokedex.Name: Ninetales
Pokedex.Description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Ninetales
Pokedex.Description: Said to live for a thousand years, this Pokémon uses its supernatural abilities to manipulate fire. It can burn its prey to a crisp as it pleases.

Pokedex.Name: Jigglypuff
Pokedex.Description: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

Pokedex.Name: Wigglytuff
Pokedex.Description: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

Pokedex.Name: Zubat
Pokedex.Description: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

Pokedex.Name: Golbat
Pokedex.Description: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

Pokedex.Name: Oddish
Pokedex.Description: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

Pokedex.Name: Gloom
Pokedex.Description: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

Pokedex.Name: Vileplume
Pokedex.Description: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

Pokedex.Name: Paras
Pokedex.Description: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.

Pokedex.Name: Parasect
Pokedex.Description: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

Pokedex.Name: Venonat
Pokedex.Description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

Pokedex.Name: Venomoth
Pokedex.Description: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

Pokedex.Name: Diglett
Pokedex.Description: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Diglett
Pokedex.Description: Many farmers cherish and nurture Diglett because its droppings enrich the soil it lives in.

Pokedex.Name: Dugtrio
Pokedex.Description: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Dugtrio
Pokedex.Description: Despite the closeness between this Pokémon and farmers and other people, no one has ever seen the parts of it concealed underground.

Pokedex.Name: Meowth
Pokedex.Description: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Meowth
Pokedex.Description: The pattern that has appeared on its giant coin is thought to be the key to unlocking the secrets of the Dynamax phenomenon.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Meowth
Pokedex.Description: It loves shiny things. It often fights with Murkrow over prey they’re both trying to catch.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Meowth
Pokedex.Description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

Pokedex.Name: Persian
Pokedex.Description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Persian
Pokedex.Description: It has a high opinion of itself, although not to the same extent as the Alolan Persian. It’s quite difficult to make friends with this Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Psyduck
Pokedex.Description: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

Pokedex.Name: Golduck
Pokedex.Description: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

Pokedex.Name: Mankey
Pokedex.Description: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

Pokedex.Name: Primeape
Pokedex.Description: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level up + using Rage Fist 20 times

Pokedex.Name: Growlithe
Pokedex.Description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Growlithe
Pokedex.Description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

Pokedex.Name: Arcanine
Pokedex.Description: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Arcanine
Pokedex.Description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

Pokedex.Name: Poliwag
Pokedex.Description: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

Pokedex.Name: Poliwhirl
Pokedex.Description: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

Pokedex.Name: Poliwrath
Pokedex.Description: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

Pokedex.Name: Abra
Pokedex.Description: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

Pokedex.Name: Kadabra
Pokedex.Description: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

Pokedex.Name: Alakazam
Pokedex.Description: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Alakazam
Pokedex.Description: Its hidden psychic power has been unleashed. A glance at someone gives it knowledge of the course of that person's life, from birth to death.

Pokedex.Name: Machop
Pokedex.Description: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

Pokedex.Name: Machoke
Pokedex.Description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

Pokedex.Name: Machamp
Pokedex.Description: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Machamp
Pokedex.Description: One of these Pokémon once used its immeasurable strength to lift a large ship that was in trouble. It then carried the ship to port.

Pokedex.Name: Bellsprout
Pokedex.Description: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

Pokedex.Name: Weepinbell
Pokedex.Description: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

Pokedex.Name: Victreebel
Pokedex.Description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

Pokedex.Name: Tentacool
Pokedex.Description: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

Pokedex.Name: Tentacruel
Pokedex.Description: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

Pokedex.Name: Geodude
Pokedex.Description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Geodude
Pokedex.Description: There are plenty of them to be found along any road. A scholar with too much free time once counted a hundred of them along a single route.

Pokedex.Name: Graveler
Pokedex.Description: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Graveler
Pokedex.Description: This slow-footed Pokémon moves by curling up and rolling instead of walking. With enough momentum, its speed can exceed 60 mph.

Pokedex.Name: Golem
Pokedex.Description: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Golem
Pokedex.Description: Once a year, this Pokémon molts, and its shed shell returns to the soil. This process creates enriched soil, so farmers collect the shells.

Pokedex.Name: Ponyta
Pokedex.Description: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Ponyta
Pokedex.Description: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

Pokedex.Name: Rapidash
Pokedex.Description: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Rapidash
Pokedex.Description: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

Pokedex.Name: Slowpoke
Pokedex.Description: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Slowpoke
Pokedex.Description: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Slowbro
Pokedex.Description: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Slowbro
Pokedex.Description: converts into impregnable armor. There is virtually no change in

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Slowbro
Pokedex.Description: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

Pokedex.Name: Magnemite
Pokedex.Description: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

Pokedex.Name: Magneton
Pokedex.Description: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

Pokedex.Name: Farfetch'd
Pokedex.Description: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Farfetch'd
Pokedex.Description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

Pokedex.Name: Doduo
Pokedex.Description: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

Pokedex.Name: Dodrio
Pokedex.Description: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

Pokedex.Name: Seel
Pokedex.Description: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

Pokedex.Name: Dewgong
Pokedex.Description: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

Pokedex.Name: Grimer
Pokedex.Description: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Grimer
Pokedex.Description: It was born from sludge transformed by exposure to X-rays from the moon. When its internal load of germs decreases, it dies.

Pokedex.Name: Muk
Pokedex.Description: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Muk
Pokedex.Description: After recent environmental improvements, this Pokémon is now hardly seen at all. People speculate that it may go extinct at some point.

Pokedex.Name: Shellder
Pokedex.Description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

Pokedex.Name: Cloyster
Pokedex.Description: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

Pokedex.Name: Gastly
Pokedex.Description: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

Pokedex.Name: Haunter
Pokedex.Description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.

Pokedex.Name: Gengar
Pokedex.Description: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Gengar
Pokedex.Description: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Gengar
Pokedex.Description: It can pass through other dimensions and appear anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck just one leg out of a wall.

Pokedex.Name: Onix
Pokedex.Description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

Pokedex.Name: Drowzee
Pokedex.Description: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

Pokedex.Name: Hypno
Pokedex.Description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

Pokedex.Name: Krabby
Pokedex.Description: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

Pokedex.Name: Kingler
Pokedex.Description: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Kingler
Pokedex.Description: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

Pokedex.Name: Voltorb
Pokedex.Description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Voltorb
Pokedex.Description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

Pokedex.Name: Electrode
Pokedex.Description: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Electrode
Pokedex.Description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

Pokedex.Name: Exeggcute
Pokedex.Description: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

Pokedex.Name: Exeggutor
Pokedex.Description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Exeggutor
Pokedex.Description: When the time comes, one of its three heads falls off. Before long, the fallen head grows into an Exeggcute.

Pokedex.Name: Cubone
Pokedex.Description: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.

Pokedex.Name: Marowak
Pokedex.Description: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

Pokedex.Name: Alolan Marowak
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is out for vengeance on its natural enemy, Mandibuzz. It throws bones like boomerangs to try to take it down.

Pokedex.Name: Hitmonlee
Pokedex.Description: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

Pokedex.Name: Hitmonchan
Pokedex.Description: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

Pokedex.Name: Lickitung
Pokedex.Description: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Koffing
Pokedex.Description: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

Pokedex.Name: Weezing
Pokedex.Description: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Weezing
Pokedex.Description: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

Pokedex.Name: Rhyhorn
Pokedex.Description: A POKéMON with a one-track mind. Once it charges,  it won't stop running until it falls asleep.

Pokedex.Name: Rhydon
Pokedex.Description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

Pokedex.Name: Chansey
Pokedex.Description: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

Pokedex.Name: Tangela
Pokedex.Description: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.

Pokedex.Name: Kangaskhan
Pokedex.Description: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Kangaskhan
Pokedex.Description: Thanks to Mega Evolution, its child grows. But as the child is good only at fighting and nothing else, its mother feels uneasy about its future.

Pokedex.Name: Horsea
Pokedex.Description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

Pokedex.Name: Seadra
Pokedex.Description: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

Pokedex.Name: Goldeen
Pokedex.Description: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

Pokedex.Name: Seaking
Pokedex.Description: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

Pokedex.Name: Staryu
Pokedex.Description: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

Pokedex.Name: Starmie
Pokedex.Description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

Pokedex.Name: Mr. Mime
Pokedex.Description: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Mr. Mime
Pokedex.Description: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

Pokedex.Name: Scyther
Pokedex.Description: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

Pokedex.Name: Jynx
Pokedex.Description: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

Pokedex.Name: Electabuzz
Pokedex.Description: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

Pokedex.Name: Magmar
Pokedex.Description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

Pokedex.Name: Pinsir
Pokedex.Description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Pinsir
Pokedex.Description: The influence of Mega Evolution leaves it in a state of constant excitement. It pierces enemies with its two large horns before shredding them.

Pokedex.Name: Tauros
Pokedex.Description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

Pokedex.Name: Paldean Tauros (Combat Breed)
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon has a thick, powerful neck. It charges at its opponents, striking them with its horns.

Pokedex.Name: Paldean Tauros (Blaze Breed)
Pokedex.Description: When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.

Pokedex.Name: Paldean Tauros (Aqua Breed)
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon swims by vigorously waving its intentionally thick neck. Water streams from the tips of its horns.

Pokedex.Name: Magikarp
Pokedex.Description: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

Pokedex.Name: Gyarados
Pokedex.Description: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Gyarados
Pokedex.Description: Although it obeys its instinctive drive to destroy everything within its reach, it will respond to orders from a Trainer it truly trusts.

Pokedex.Name: Lapras
Pokedex.Description: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Lapras
Pokedex.Description: January 19 to February 29, 2020

Pokedex.Name: Ditto
Pokedex.Description: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

Pokedex.Name: Eevee
Pokedex.Description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + High Friendship, at Day
Level Up + High Friendship, at Night
Level Up + High Friendship, knowing Fairy move

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Eevee
Pokedex.Description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

Pokedex.Name: Vaporeon
Pokedex.Description: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

Pokedex.Name: Jolteon
Pokedex.Description: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

Pokedex.Name: Flareon
Pokedex.Description: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

Pokedex.Name: Porygon
Pokedex.Description: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

Pokedex.Name: Omanyte
Pokedex.Description: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

Pokedex.Name: Omastar
Pokedex.Description: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

Pokedex.Name: Kabuto
Pokedex.Description: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

Pokedex.Name: Kabutops
Pokedex.Description: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

Pokedex.Name: Aerodactyl
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Aerodactyl
Pokedex.Description: When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious than ever before. Some say that's because its excess of power is causing it pain.

Pokedex.Name: Snorlax
Pokedex.Description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Snorlax
Pokedex.Description: Gigantamax energy has affected stray seeds and even pebbles that got stuck to Snorlax, making them grow to a huge size.

Pokedex.Name: Articuno
Pokedex.Description: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Articuno
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

Pokedex.Name: Zapdos
Pokedex.Description: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Zapdos
Pokedex.Description: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

Pokedex.Name: Moltres
Pokedex.Description: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Moltres
Pokedex.Description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

Pokedex.Name: Dratini
Pokedex.Description: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

Pokedex.Name: Dragonair
Pokedex.Description: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

Pokedex.Name: Dragonite
Pokedex.Description: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

Pokedex.Name: Mewtwo
Pokedex.Description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Mewtwo X
Pokedex.Description: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Mewtwo Y
Pokedex.Description: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

Pokedex.Name: Mew
Pokedex.Description: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

Pokedex.Name: Chikorita
Pokedex.Description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

Pokedex.Name: Bayleef
Pokedex.Description: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

Pokedex.Name: Meganium
Pokedex.Description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

Pokedex.Name: Cyndaquil
Pokedex.Description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

Pokedex.Name: Quilava
Pokedex.Description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

Pokedex.Name: Typhlosion
Pokedex.Description: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Typhlosion
Pokedex.Description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

Pokedex.Name: Totodile
Pokedex.Description: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

Pokedex.Name: Croconaw
Pokedex.Description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Feraligatr
Pokedex.Description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

Pokedex.Name: Sentret
Pokedex.Description: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

Pokedex.Name: Furret
Pokedex.Description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.

Pokedex.Name: Hoothoot
Pokedex.Description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

Pokedex.Name: Noctowl
Pokedex.Description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

Pokedex.Name: Ledyba
Pokedex.Description: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

Pokedex.Name: Ledian
Pokedex.Description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

Pokedex.Name: Spinarak
Pokedex.Description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

Pokedex.Name: Ariados
Pokedex.Description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.

Pokedex.Name: Crobat
Pokedex.Description: It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

Pokedex.Name: Chinchou
Pokedex.Description: Chinchou blink their shining antennae at one another to claim their respective turf.

Pokedex.Name: Lanturn
Pokedex.Description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

Pokedex.Name: Pichu
Pokedex.Description: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

Pokedex.Name: Cleffa
Pokedex.Description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

Pokedex.Name: Igglybuff
Pokedex.Description: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

Pokedex.Name: Togepi
Pokedex.Description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

Pokedex.Name: Togetic
Pokedex.Description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car­ ing people and shower them with happiness.

Pokedex.Name: Natu
Pokedex.Description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.

Pokedex.Name: Xatu
Pokedex.Description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

Pokedex.Name: Mareep
Pokedex.Description: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

Pokedex.Name: Flaaffy
Pokedex.Description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

Pokedex.Name: Ampharos
Pokedex.Description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Ampharos
Pokedex.Description: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

Pokedex.Name: Bellossom
Pokedex.Description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

Pokedex.Name: Marill
Pokedex.Description: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.

Pokedex.Name: Azumarill
Pokedex.Description: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

Pokedex.Name: Sudowoodo
Pokedex.Description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi­ tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

Pokedex.Name: Politoed
Pokedex.Description: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.

Pokedex.Name: Hoppip
Pokedex.Description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

Pokedex.Name: Skiploom
Pokedex.Description: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.

Pokedex.Name: Jumpluff
Pokedex.Description: Once it catches the wind, it deft­ ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

Pokedex.Name: Aipom
Pokedex.Description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

Pokedex.Name: Sunkern
Pokedex.Description: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

Pokedex.Name: Sunflora
Pokedex.Description: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

Pokedex.Name: Yanma
Pokedex.Description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.

Pokedex.Name: Wooper
Pokedex.Description: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

Pokedex.Name: Paldean Wooper
Pokedex.Description: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

Pokedex.Name: Quagsire
Pokedex.Description: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

Pokedex.Name: Espeon
Pokedex.Description: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.

Pokedex.Name: Umbreon
Pokedex.Description: When agitated, this POKéMON pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

Pokedex.Name: Murkrow
Pokedex.Description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

Pokedex.Name: Slowking
Pokedex.Description: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Slowking
Pokedex.Description: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

Pokedex.Name: Misdreavus
Pokedex.Description: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

Pokedex.Name: Unown
Pokedex.Description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

Pokedex.Name: Wobbuffet
Pokedex.Description: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.

Pokedex.Name: Girafarig
Pokedex.Description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

Pokedex.Name: Pineco
Pokedex.Description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

Pokedex.Name: Forretress
Pokedex.Description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

Pokedex.Name: Dunsparce
Pokedex.Description: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.

Pokedex.Name: Gligar
Pokedex.Description: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + at Night, holding Razor Fang

Pokedex.Name: Steelix
Pokedex.Description: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Steelix
Pokedex.Description: To protect itself from opponents' attacks, it uses magnetism to control pieces of its hard outer shell that have flaked off.

Pokedex.Name: Snubbull
Pokedex.Description: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

Pokedex.Name: Granbull
Pokedex.Description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

Pokedex.Name: Qwilfish
Pokedex.Description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Qwilfish
Pokedex.Description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

Pokedex.Name: Scizor
Pokedex.Description: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Scizor
Pokedex.Description: The excess energy that bathes this Pokémon keeps it in constant danger of overflow. It can't sustain a battle over long periods of time.

Pokedex.Name: Shuckle
Pokedex.Description: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

Pokedex.Name: Heracross
Pokedex.Description: It is usually docile, but if it is disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Heracross
Pokedex.Description: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

Pokedex.Name: Sneasel
Pokedex.Description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + at Night, holding Razor Claw
Level Up + at Day, holding Razor Claw

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Sneasel
Pokedex.Description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

Pokedex.Name: Teddiursa
Pokedex.Description: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

Pokedex.Name: Ursaring
Pokedex.Description: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.

Pokedex.Name: Slugma
Pokedex.Description: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

Pokedex.Name: Magcargo
Pokedex.Description: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

Pokedex.Name: Swinub
Pokedex.Description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

Pokedex.Name: Piloswine
Pokedex.Description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

Pokedex.Name: Corsola
Pokedex.Description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Corsola
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

Pokedex.Name: Remoraid
Pokedex.Description: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

Pokedex.Name: Octillery
Pokedex.Description: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

Pokedex.Name: Delibird
Pokedex.Description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

Pokedex.Name: Mantine
Pokedex.Description: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

Pokedex.Name: Skarmory
Pokedex.Description: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

Pokedex.Name: Houndour
Pokedex.Description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

Pokedex.Name: Houndoom
Pokedex.Description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Houndoom
Pokedex.Description: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

Pokedex.Name: Kingdra
Pokedex.Description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

Pokedex.Name: Phanpy
Pokedex.Description: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.

Pokedex.Name: Donphan
Pokedex.Description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.

Pokedex.Name: Porygon2
Pokedex.Description: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

Pokedex.Name: Stantler
Pokedex.Description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.

Pokedex.Name: Smeargle
Pokedex.Description: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

Pokedex.Name: Tyrogue
Pokedex.Description: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

Pokedex.Name: Hitmontop
Pokedex.Description: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.

Pokedex.Name: Smoochum
Pokedex.Description: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

Pokedex.Name: Elekid
Pokedex.Description: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

Pokedex.Name: Magby
Pokedex.Description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

Pokedex.Name: Miltank
Pokedex.Description: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

Pokedex.Name: Blissey
Pokedex.Description: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.

Pokedex.Name: Raikou
Pokedex.Description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

Pokedex.Name: Entei
Pokedex.Description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

Pokedex.Name: Suicune
Pokedex.Description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

Pokedex.Name: Larvitar
Pokedex.Description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

Pokedex.Name: Pupitar
Pokedex.Description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.

Pokedex.Name: Tyranitar
Pokedex.Description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Tyranitar
Pokedex.Description: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

Pokedex.Name: Lugia
Pokedex.Description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

Pokedex.Name: Ho-Oh
Pokedex.Description: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.

Pokedex.Name: Celebi
Pokedex.Description: This POKéMON wan­ ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

Pokedex.Name: Treecko
Pokedex.Description: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

Pokedex.Name: Grovyle
Pokedex.Description: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

Pokedex.Name: Sceptile
Pokedex.Description: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Sceptile
Pokedex.Description: The seeds on its back are filled with energy from Mega Evolution. The Pokémon detonates these seeds to launch the tip of its tail.

Pokedex.Name: Torchic
Pokedex.Description: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

Pokedex.Name: Combusken
Pokedex.Description: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.

Pokedex.Name: Blaziken
Pokedex.Description: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Blaziken
Pokedex.Description: Boiling-hot blood courses through its entire body, doubling the sharpness of its moves. It subdues opponents in the blink of an eye.

Pokedex.Name: Mudkip
Pokedex.Description: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

Pokedex.Name: Marshtomp
Pokedex.Description: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

Pokedex.Name: Swampert
Pokedex.Description: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Swampert
Pokedex.Description: The water within its body further strengthens its already enlarged muscles, using the same principles as a hydraulic pump.

Pokedex.Name: Poochyena
Pokedex.Description: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

Pokedex.Name: Mightyena
Pokedex.Description: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

Pokedex.Name: Zigzagoon
Pokedex.Description: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Zigzagoon
Pokedex.Description: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

Pokedex.Name: Linoone
Pokedex.Description: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Linoone
Pokedex.Description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

Pokedex.Name: Wurmple
Pokedex.Description: Using the spikes on its rear end,   WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.

Pokedex.Name: Silcoon
Pokedex.Description: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There,  this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.

Pokedex.Name: Beautifly
Pokedex.Description: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.

Pokedex.Name: Cascoon
Pokedex.Description: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

Pokedex.Name: Dustox
Pokedex.Description: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.

Pokedex.Name: Lotad
Pokedex.Description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

Pokedex.Name: Lombre
Pokedex.Description: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

Pokedex.Name: Ludicolo
Pokedex.Description: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.

Pokedex.Name: Seedot
Pokedex.Description: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.

Pokedex.Name: Nuzleaf
Pokedex.Description: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.

Pokedex.Name: Shiftry
Pokedex.Description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

Pokedex.Name: Taillow
Pokedex.Description: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

Pokedex.Name: Swellow
Pokedex.Description: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.

Pokedex.Name: Wingull
Pokedex.Description: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.

Pokedex.Name: Pelipper
Pokedex.Description: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

Pokedex.Name: Ralts
Pokedex.Description: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.

Pokedex.Name: Kirlia
Pokedex.Description: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.

Pokedex.Name: Gardevoir
Pokedex.Description: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Gardevoir
Pokedex.Description: When it opens the red plate on its chest and unleashes its heart, its strongest psychic power is released.

Pokedex.Name: Surskit
Pokedex.Description: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.

Pokedex.Name: Masquerain
Pokedex.Description: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.

Pokedex.Name: Shroomish
Pokedex.Description: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

Pokedex.Name: Breloom
Pokedex.Description: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

Pokedex.Name: Slakoth
Pokedex.Description: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

Pokedex.Name: Vigoroth
Pokedex.Description: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.

Pokedex.Name: Slaking
Pokedex.Description: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.

Pokedex.Name: Nincada
Pokedex.Description: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.

Pokedex.Name: Ninjask
Pokedex.Description: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.

Pokedex.Name: Shedinja
Pokedex.Description: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.

Pokedex.Name: Whismur
Pokedex.Description: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.

Pokedex.Name: Loudred
Pokedex.Description: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.

Pokedex.Name: Exploud
Pokedex.Description: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.

Pokedex.Name: Makuhita
Pokedex.Description: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.

Pokedex.Name: Hariyama
Pokedex.Description: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It’s been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

Pokedex.Name: Azurill
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

Pokedex.Name: Nosepass
Pokedex.Description: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.

Pokedex.Name: Skitty
Pokedex.Description: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

Pokedex.Name: Delcatty
Pokedex.Description: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

Pokedex.Name: Sableye
Pokedex.Description: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Sableye
Pokedex.Description: The jewel from its chest, which has grown gigantic due to the effects of Mega Evolution, can turn back any attack.

Pokedex.Name: Mawile
Pokedex.Description: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Mawile
Pokedex.Description: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

Pokedex.Name: Aron
Pokedex.Description: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

Pokedex.Name: Lairon
Pokedex.Description: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

Pokedex.Name: Aggron
Pokedex.Description: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Aggron
Pokedex.Description: Energy from Mega Evolution has turned the iron inside this Pokémon into steel armor that covers Mega Aggron's whole body.

Pokedex.Name: Meditite
Pokedex.Description: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

Pokedex.Name: Medicham
Pokedex.Description: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Medicham
Pokedex.Description: Thanks to Mega Evolution, its mental power is limitless. It conjures up arms imbued with malice to defeat its enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Electrike
Pokedex.Description: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.

Pokedex.Name: Manectric
Pokedex.Description: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Manectric
Pokedex.Description: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

Pokedex.Name: Plusle
Pokedex.Description: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

Pokedex.Name: Minun
Pokedex.Description: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

Pokedex.Name: Volbeat
Pokedex.Description: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.

Pokedex.Name: Illumise
Pokedex.Description: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

Pokedex.Name: Roselia
Pokedex.Description: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.

Pokedex.Name: Gulpin
Pokedex.Description: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

Pokedex.Name: Swalot
Pokedex.Description: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Carvanha
Pokedex.Description: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.

Pokedex.Name: Sharpedo
Pokedex.Description: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Sharpedo
Pokedex.Description: As a consequence of Mega Evolution, its combative instincts exploded. The yellow marks it bears are scars from a long history of battles.

Pokedex.Name: Wailmer
Pokedex.Description: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.

Pokedex.Name: Wailord
Pokedex.Description: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Numel
Pokedex.Description: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

Pokedex.Name: Camerupt
Pokedex.Description: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Camerupt
Pokedex.Description: When this Pokémon's rage reaches a boiling point, the huge volcano in the hump on its back erupts violently, spewing molten lava.

Pokedex.Name: Torkoal
Pokedex.Description: You can tell how it’s feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

Pokedex.Name: Spoink
Pokedex.Description: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.

Pokedex.Name: Grumpig
Pokedex.Description: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

Pokedex.Name: Spinda
Pokedex.Description: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

Pokedex.Name: Trapinch
Pokedex.Description: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.

Pokedex.Name: Vibrava
Pokedex.Description: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.

Pokedex.Name: Flygon
Pokedex.Description: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental  spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.

Pokedex.Name: Cacnea
Pokedex.Description: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

Pokedex.Name: Cacturne
Pokedex.Description: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

Pokedex.Name: Swablu
Pokedex.Description: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

Pokedex.Name: Altaria
Pokedex.Description: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Altaria
Pokedex.Description: Its down is so soft, it seems as if a touch could melt it. But it's strong enough that just a few strands could be used to hoist a dump truck.

Pokedex.Name: Zangoose
Pokedex.Description: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

Pokedex.Name: Seviper
Pokedex.Description: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.

Pokedex.Name: Lunatone
Pokedex.Description: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.

Pokedex.Name: Solrock
Pokedex.Description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

Pokedex.Name: Barboach
Pokedex.Description: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.

Pokedex.Name: Whiscash
Pokedex.Description: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.

Pokedex.Name: Corphish
Pokedex.Description: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

Pokedex.Name: Crawdaunt
Pokedex.Description: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.

Pokedex.Name: Baltoy
Pokedex.Description: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.

Pokedex.Name: Claydol
Pokedex.Description: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.

Pokedex.Name: Lileep
Pokedex.Description: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles  shaped like flower petals.

Pokedex.Name: Cradily
Pokedex.Description: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

Pokedex.Name: Anorith
Pokedex.Description: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

Pokedex.Name: Armaldo
Pokedex.Description: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

Pokedex.Name: Feebas
Pokedex.Description: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.

Pokedex.Name: Milotic
Pokedex.Description: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

Pokedex.Name: Castform
Pokedex.Description: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

Pokedex.Name: Castform Sunny
Pokedex.Description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

Pokedex.Name: Castform Rainy
Pokedex.Description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

Pokedex.Name: Castform Snowy
Pokedex.Description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

Pokedex.Name: Kecleon
Pokedex.Description: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

Pokedex.Name: Shuppet
Pokedex.Description: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.

Pokedex.Name: Banette
Pokedex.Description: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Banette
Pokedex.Description: Mega Evolution increases its vindictiveness, and the cursing power that was held back by its zipper comes spilling out.

Pokedex.Name: Duskull
Pokedex.Description: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.

Pokedex.Name: Dusclops
Pokedex.Description: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.

Pokedex.Name: Tropius
Pokedex.Description: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.

Pokedex.Name: Chimecho
Pokedex.Description: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.

Pokedex.Name: Absol
Pokedex.Description: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Absol
Pokedex.Description: As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it, its fur bristles. What you see on its back are not true wings, and this Pokémon isn't able to fly.

Pokedex.Name: Wynaut
Pokedex.Description: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.

Pokedex.Name: Snorunt
Pokedex.Description: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.

Pokedex.Name: Glalie
Pokedex.Description: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Glalie
Pokedex.Description: The power of Mega Evolution was so strong that it smashed Glalie's jaw. Its inability to eat very well leaves Glalie irritated.

Pokedex.Name: Spheal
Pokedex.Description: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than  walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.

Pokedex.Name: Sealeo
Pokedex.Description: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.

Pokedex.Name: Walrein
Pokedex.Description: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

Pokedex.Name: Clamperl
Pokedex.Description: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

Pokedex.Name: Huntail
Pokedex.Description: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.

Pokedex.Name: Gorebyss
Pokedex.Description: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

Pokedex.Name: Relicanth
Pokedex.Description: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Luvdisc
Pokedex.Description: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.

Pokedex.Name: Bagon
Pokedex.Description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

Pokedex.Name: Shelgon
Pokedex.Description: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.

Pokedex.Name: Salamence
Pokedex.Description: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Salamence
Pokedex.Description: It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds over all kinds of topographical features.

Pokedex.Name: Beldum
Pokedex.Description: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

Pokedex.Name: Metang
Pokedex.Description: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.

Pokedex.Name: Metagross
Pokedex.Description: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Metagross
Pokedex.Description: Mega Evolution stimulated its brain. It emerged as a ruthless Pokémon that will clutch at any means of ensuring its victories.

Pokedex.Name: Regirock
