Pokedex.Description: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

Pokedex.Name: Regice
Pokedex.Description: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.

Pokedex.Name: Registeel
Pokedex.Description: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.

Pokedex.Name: Latias
Pokedex.Description: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Latias
Pokedex.Description: Other forms may have other colors.

Pokedex.Name: Latios
Pokedex.Description: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Latios
Pokedex.Description: Other forms may have other colors.

Pokedex.Name: Kyogre
Pokedex.Description: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.

Pokedex.Name: Primal Kyogre
Pokedex.Description: Kyogre reverted to this state via the Blue Orb, which contains the energy of the primordial world. Kyogre's body resembles seawater.

Pokedex.Name: Groudon
Pokedex.Description: GROUDON has long been described in  mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.

Pokedex.Name: Primal Groudon
Pokedex.Description: This is Groudon's true form, restored using the Red Orb. Energy spills from its body in the form of magma.

Pokedex.Name: Rayquaza
Pokedex.Description: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer,  never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Rayquaza
Pokedex.Description: A shooting star streaking across the night sky may, in fact, be Mega Rayquaza flying gracefully after a meteoroid.

Pokedex.Name: Jirachi
Pokedex.Description: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.

Pokedex.Name: Deoxys
Pokedex.Description: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.

Pokedex.Name: Deoxys Normal Forme
Pokedex.Description: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.

Pokedex.Name: Deoxys Attack Forme
Pokedex.Description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

Pokedex.Name: Deoxys Defense Forme
Pokedex.Description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

Pokedex.Name: Deoxys Speed Forme
Pokedex.Description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

Pokedex.Name: Turtwig
Pokedex.Description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

Pokedex.Name: Grotle
Pokedex.Description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

Pokedex.Name: Torterra
Pokedex.Description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

Pokedex.Name: Chimchar
Pokedex.Description: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

Pokedex.Name: Monferno
Pokedex.Description: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

Pokedex.Name: Infernape
Pokedex.Description: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

Pokedex.Name: Piplup
Pokedex.Description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

Pokedex.Name: Prinplup
Pokedex.Description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

Pokedex.Name: Empoleon
Pokedex.Description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

Pokedex.Name: Starly
Pokedex.Description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

Pokedex.Name: Staravia
Pokedex.Description: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

Pokedex.Name: Staraptor
Pokedex.Description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

Pokedex.Name: Bidoof
Pokedex.Description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

Pokedex.Name: Bibarel
Pokedex.Description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

Pokedex.Name: Kricketot
Pokedex.Description: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

Pokedex.Name: Kricketune
Pokedex.Description: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

Pokedex.Name: Shinx
Pokedex.Description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

Pokedex.Name: Luxio
Pokedex.Description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

Pokedex.Name: Luxray
Pokedex.Description: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

Pokedex.Name: Budew
Pokedex.Description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + High Friendship, at Day

Pokedex.Name: Roserade
Pokedex.Description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

Pokedex.Name: Cranidos
Pokedex.Description: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

Pokedex.Name: Rampardos
Pokedex.Description: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

Pokedex.Name: Shieldon
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

Pokedex.Name: Bastiodon
Pokedex.Description: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

Pokedex.Name: Burmy
Pokedex.Description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

Pokedex.Name: Burmy Plant Cloak
Pokedex.Description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

Pokedex.Name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
Pokedex.Description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

Pokedex.Name: Burmy Trash Cloak
Pokedex.Description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

Pokedex.Name: Wormadam
Pokedex.Description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

Pokedex.Name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
Pokedex.Description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

Pokedex.Name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
Pokedex.Description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

Pokedex.Name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
Pokedex.Description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

Pokedex.Name: Mothim
Pokedex.Description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

Pokedex.Name: Combee
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

Pokedex.Name: Vespiquen
Pokedex.Description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

Pokedex.Name: Pachirisu
Pokedex.Description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

Pokedex.Name: Buizel
Pokedex.Description: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

Pokedex.Name: Floatzel
Pokedex.Description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

Pokedex.Name: Cherubi
Pokedex.Description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

Pokedex.Name: Cherrim Overcast Form
Pokedex.Description: Flower Garden: The Garden at the End of Time

Pokedex.Name: Cherrim Sunshine Form
Pokedex.Description: Flower Garden: The Garden at the End of Time

Pokedex.Name: Shellos
Pokedex.Description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

Pokedex.Name: West Shellos
Pokedex.Description: Our bodies look different depending on where we're from. Where you come from counts!

Pokedex.Name: East Shellos
Pokedex.Description: Our bodies look different depending on where we're from. Where you come from counts!

Pokedex.Name: Gastrodon
Pokedex.Description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

Pokedex.Name: West Gastrodon
Pokedex.Description: type. Although Gastrodon has a flexible body, it is tough, allowing it to absorb sharp blows.

Pokedex.Name: East Gastrodon
Pokedex.Description: Gastrodon, the Sea Slug Pokémon and the evolved form of Shellos. A sturdy shell covered Gastrodon's back long ago. Its cells still contain evidence of it today.

Pokedex.Name: Ambipom
Pokedex.Description: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

Pokedex.Name: Drifloon
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

Pokedex.Name: Drifblim
Pokedex.Description: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

Pokedex.Name: Buneary
Pokedex.Description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

Pokedex.Name: Lopunny
Pokedex.Description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Lopunny
Pokedex.Description: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.

Pokedex.Name: Mismagius
Pokedex.Description: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

Pokedex.Name: Honchkrow
Pokedex.Description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

Pokedex.Name: Glameow
Pokedex.Description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

Pokedex.Name: Purugly
Pokedex.Description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

Pokedex.Name: Chingling
Pokedex.Description: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + High Friendship, at Night

Pokedex.Name: Stunky
Pokedex.Description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

Pokedex.Name: Skuntank
Pokedex.Description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

Pokedex.Name: Bronzor
Pokedex.Description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

Pokedex.Name: Bronzong
Pokedex.Description: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

Pokedex.Name: Bonsly
Pokedex.Description: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.

Pokedex.Name: Mime Jr.
Pokedex.Description: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + knowing Mimic, at Galar

Pokedex.Name: Happiny
Pokedex.Description: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + at Day, holding Oval Stone

Pokedex.Name: Chatot
Pokedex.Description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

Pokedex.Name: Spiritomb
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

Pokedex.Name: Gible
Pokedex.Description: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

Pokedex.Name: Gabite
Pokedex.Description: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

Pokedex.Name: Garchomp
Pokedex.Description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Garchomp
Pokedex.Description: Its disposition is more vicious than before its Mega Evolution. Garchomp carves its opponents up with the scythes on both arms.

Pokedex.Name: Munchlax
Pokedex.Description: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

Pokedex.Name: Riolu
Pokedex.Description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

EvolvesTo.Method: Level Up + High Friendship, at Day

Pokedex.Name: Lucario
Pokedex.Description: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Lucario
Pokedex.Description: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.

Pokedex.Name: Hippopotas
Pokedex.Description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

Pokedex.Name: Hippowdon
Pokedex.Description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

Pokedex.Name: Skorupi
Pokedex.Description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

Pokedex.Name: Drapion
Pokedex.Description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

Pokedex.Name: Croagunk
Pokedex.Description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

Pokedex.Name: Toxicroak
Pokedex.Description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

Pokedex.Name: Carnivine
Pokedex.Description: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

Pokedex.Name: Finneon
Pokedex.Description: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

Pokedex.Name: Lumineon
Pokedex.Description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

Pokedex.Name: Mantyke
Pokedex.Description: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

Pokedex.Name: Snover
Pokedex.Description: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

Pokedex.Name: Abomasnow
Pokedex.Description: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Abomasnow
Pokedex.Description: The buds on its back have sprouted into impressive icicles that can whip up massive blizzards of −22 degrees Fahrenheit.

Pokedex.Name: Weavile
Pokedex.Description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

Pokedex.Name: Magnezone
Pokedex.Description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

Pokedex.Name: Lickilicky
Pokedex.Description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

Pokedex.Name: Rhyperior
Pokedex.Description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.

Pokedex.Name: Tangrowth
Pokedex.Description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

Pokedex.Name: Electivire
Pokedex.Description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

Pokedex.Name: Magmortar
Pokedex.Description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

Pokedex.Name: Togekiss
Pokedex.Description: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

Pokedex.Name: Yanmega
Pokedex.Description: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

Pokedex.Name: Leafeon
Pokedex.Description: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

Pokedex.Name: Glaceon
Pokedex.Description: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

Pokedex.Name: Gliscor
Pokedex.Description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

Pokedex.Name: Mamoswine
Pokedex.Description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

Pokedex.Name: Porygon-Z
Pokedex.Description: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

Pokedex.Name: Gallade
Pokedex.Description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Gallade
Pokedex.Description: It gets power from the bond it has with its Trainer. Mega Evolution has given it plates to slice its enemies and a cape to protect its body.

Pokedex.Name: Probopass
Pokedex.Description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

Pokedex.Name: Dusknoir
Pokedex.Description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

Pokedex.Name: Froslass
Pokedex.Description: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

Pokedex.Name: Rotom
Pokedex.Description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

Pokedex.Name: Heat Rotom
Pokedex.Description: A superscript level indicates that Rotom can learn this move normally in Generation IX

Pokedex.Name: Wash Rotom
Pokedex.Description: A superscript level indicates that Rotom can learn this move normally in Generation IX

Pokedex.Name: Frost Rotom
Pokedex.Description: A superscript level indicates that Rotom can learn this move normally in Generation IX

Pokedex.Name: Fan Rotom
Pokedex.Description: A superscript level indicates that Rotom can learn this move normally in Generation IX

Pokedex.Name: Mow Rotom
Pokedex.Description: A superscript level indicates that Rotom can learn this move normally in Generation IX

Pokedex.Name: Uxie
Pokedex.Description: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

Pokedex.Name: Mesprit
Pokedex.Description: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

Pokedex.Name: Azelf
Pokedex.Description: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

Pokedex.Name: Dialga
Pokedex.Description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

Pokedex.Name: Dialga Altered Forme
Pokedex.Description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

Pokedex.Name: Dialga Origin Forme
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

Pokedex.Name: Palkia
Pokedex.Description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

Pokedex.Name: Palkia Altered Forme
Pokedex.Description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

Pokedex.Name: Palkia Origin Forme
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

Pokedex.Name: Heatran
Pokedex.Description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

Pokedex.Name: Regigigas
Pokedex.Description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

Pokedex.Name: Giratina
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

Pokedex.Name: Giratina Altered Forme
Pokedex.Description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

Pokedex.Name: Giratina Origin Forme
Pokedex.Description: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

Pokedex.Name: Cresselia
Pokedex.Description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

Pokedex.Name: Phione
Pokedex.Description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

Pokedex.Name: Manaphy
Pokedex.Description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

Pokedex.Name: Darkrai
Pokedex.Description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

Pokedex.Name: Shaymin
Pokedex.Description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

Pokedex.Name: Shaymin Land Forme
Pokedex.Description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

Pokedex.Name: Shaymin Sky Forme
Pokedex.Description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

Pokedex.Name: Arceus
Pokedex.Description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

Pokedex.Name: Victini
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

Pokedex.Name: Snivy
Pokedex.Description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

Pokedex.Name: Servine
Pokedex.Description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

Pokedex.Name: Serperior
Pokedex.Description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

Pokedex.Name: Tepig
Pokedex.Description: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

Pokedex.Name: Pignite
Pokedex.Description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

Pokedex.Name: Emboar
Pokedex.Description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

Pokedex.Name: Oshawott
Pokedex.Description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

Pokedex.Name: Dewott
Pokedex.Description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

Pokedex.Name: Samurott
Pokedex.Description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Samurott
Pokedex.Description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

Pokedex.Name: Patrat
Pokedex.Description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

Pokedex.Name: Watchog
Pokedex.Description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

Pokedex.Name: Lillipup
Pokedex.Description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

Pokedex.Name: Herdier
Pokedex.Description: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

Pokedex.Name: Stoutland
Pokedex.Description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

Pokedex.Name: Purrloin
Pokedex.Description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

Pokedex.Name: Liepard
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

Pokedex.Name: Pansage
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

Pokedex.Name: Simisage
Pokedex.Description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

Pokedex.Name: Pansear
Pokedex.Description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

Pokedex.Name: Simisear
Pokedex.Description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

Pokedex.Name: Panpour
Pokedex.Description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

Pokedex.Name: Simipour
Pokedex.Description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

Pokedex.Name: Munna
Pokedex.Description: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

Pokedex.Name: Musharna
Pokedex.Description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Pidove
Pokedex.Description: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

Pokedex.Name: Tranquill
Pokedex.Description: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.

Pokedex.Name: Unfezant
Pokedex.Description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

Pokedex.Name: Blitzle
Pokedex.Description: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

Pokedex.Name: Zebstrika
Pokedex.Description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

Pokedex.Name: Roggenrola
Pokedex.Description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

Pokedex.Name: Boldore
Pokedex.Description: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

Pokedex.Name: Gigalith
Pokedex.Description: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

Pokedex.Name: Woobat
Pokedex.Description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

Pokedex.Name: Swoobat
Pokedex.Description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

Pokedex.Name: Drilbur
Pokedex.Description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

Pokedex.Name: Excadrill
Pokedex.Description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

Pokedex.Name: Audino
Pokedex.Description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Audino
Pokedex.Description: Other forms may have other colors.

Pokedex.Name: Timburr
Pokedex.Description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

Pokedex.Name: Gurdurr
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

Pokedex.Name: Conkeldurr
Pokedex.Description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

Pokedex.Name: Tympole
Pokedex.Description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

Pokedex.Name: Palpitoad
Pokedex.Description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

Pokedex.Name: Seismitoad
Pokedex.Description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

Pokedex.Name: Throh
Pokedex.Description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

Pokedex.Name: Sawk
Pokedex.Description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

Pokedex.Name: Sewaddle
Pokedex.Description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

Pokedex.Name: Swadloon
Pokedex.Description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

Pokedex.Name: Leavanny
Pokedex.Description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

Pokedex.Name: Venipede
Pokedex.Description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

Pokedex.Name: Whirlipede
Pokedex.Description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Scolipede
Pokedex.Description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

Pokedex.Name: Cottonee
Pokedex.Description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

Pokedex.Name: Whimsicott
Pokedex.Description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

Pokedex.Name: Petilil
Pokedex.Description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

Pokedex.Name: Lilligant
Pokedex.Description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Lilligant
Pokedex.Description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

Pokedex.Name: Basculin
Pokedex.Description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

Pokedex.Name: Basculin Red-Striped
Pokedex.Description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

Pokedex.Name: Basculin Blue-Striped
Pokedex.Description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

Pokedex.Name: Basculin White-Striped
Pokedex.Description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

Pokedex.Name: Sandile
Pokedex.Description: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

Pokedex.Name: Krokorok
Pokedex.Description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

Pokedex.Name: Krookodile
Pokedex.Description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

Pokedex.Name: Darumaka
Pokedex.Description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Darumaka
Pokedex.Description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

Pokedex.Name: Darmanitan
Pokedex.Description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

Pokedex.Name: Darmanitan Zen Mode
Pokedex.Description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Darmanitan Standard Mode
Pokedex.Description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Darmanitan Zen Mode
Pokedex.Description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

Pokedex.Name: Maractus
Pokedex.Description: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

Pokedex.Name: Dwebble
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Crustle
Pokedex.Description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

Pokedex.Name: Scraggy
Pokedex.Description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

Pokedex.Name: Scrafty
Pokedex.Description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Sigilyph
Pokedex.Description: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

Pokedex.Name: Yamask
Pokedex.Description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Yamask
Pokedex.Description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

Pokedex.Name: Cofagrigus
Pokedex.Description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

Pokedex.Name: Tirtouga
Pokedex.Description: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

Pokedex.Name: Carracosta
Pokedex.Description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

Pokedex.Name: Archen
Pokedex.Description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

Pokedex.Name: Archeops
Pokedex.Description: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

Pokedex.Name: Trubbish
Pokedex.Description: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

Pokedex.Name: Garbodor
Pokedex.Description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Garbodor
Pokedex.Description: It sprays toxic gas from its mouth and fingers. If the gas engulfs you, the toxins will seep in all the way down to your bones.

Pokedex.Name: Zorua
Pokedex.Description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Zorua
Pokedex.Description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

Pokedex.Name: Zoroark
Pokedex.Description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Zoroark
Pokedex.Description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

Pokedex.Name: Minccino
Pokedex.Description: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

Pokedex.Name: Cinccino
Pokedex.Description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

Pokedex.Name: Gothita
Pokedex.Description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

Pokedex.Name: Gothorita
Pokedex.Description: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

Pokedex.Name: Gothitelle
Pokedex.Description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

Pokedex.Name: Solosis
Pokedex.Description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

Pokedex.Name: Duosion
Pokedex.Description: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

Pokedex.Name: Reuniclus
Pokedex.Description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

Pokedex.Name: Ducklett
Pokedex.Description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

Pokedex.Name: Swanna
Pokedex.Description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

Pokedex.Name: Vanillite
Pokedex.Description: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

Pokedex.Name: Vanillish
Pokedex.Description: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

Pokedex.Name: Vanilluxe
Pokedex.Description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

Pokedex.Name: Deerling
Pokedex.Description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

Pokedex.Name: Deerling Spring Form
Pokedex.Description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

Pokedex.Name: Deerling Summer Form
Pokedex.Description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

Pokedex.Name: Deerling Autumn Form
Pokedex.Description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

Pokedex.Name: Deerling Winter Form
Pokedex.Description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

Pokedex.Name: Sawsbuck
Pokedex.Description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

Pokedex.Name: Sawsbuck Spring Form
Pokedex.Description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

Pokedex.Name: Sawsbuck Summer Form
Pokedex.Description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

Pokedex.Name: Sawsbuck Autumn Form
Pokedex.Description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

Pokedex.Name: Sawsbuck Winter Form
Pokedex.Description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

Pokedex.Name: Emolga
Pokedex.Description: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

Pokedex.Name: Karrablast
Pokedex.Description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

Pokedex.Name: Escavalier
Pokedex.Description: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

Pokedex.Name: Foongus
Pokedex.Description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

Pokedex.Name: Amoonguss
Pokedex.Description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

Pokedex.Name: Frillish
Pokedex.Description: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

Pokedex.Name: Jellicent
Pokedex.Description: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

Pokedex.Name: Alomomola
Pokedex.Description: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

Pokedex.Name: Joltik
Pokedex.Description: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

Pokedex.Name: Galvantula
Pokedex.Description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

Pokedex.Name: Ferroseed
Pokedex.Description: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

Pokedex.Name: Ferrothorn
Pokedex.Description: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

Pokedex.Name: Klink
Pokedex.Description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

Pokedex.Name: Klang
Pokedex.Description: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

Pokedex.Name: Klinklang
Pokedex.Description: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

Pokedex.Name: Tynamo
Pokedex.Description: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

Pokedex.Name: Eelektrik
Pokedex.Description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

Pokedex.Name: Eelektross
Pokedex.Description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

Pokedex.Name: Elgyem
Pokedex.Description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.

Pokedex.Name: Beheeyem
Pokedex.Description: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

Pokedex.Name: Litwick
Pokedex.Description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

Pokedex.Name: Lampent
Pokedex.Description: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

Pokedex.Name: Chandelure
Pokedex.Description: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

Pokedex.Name: Axew
Pokedex.Description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

Pokedex.Name: Fraxure
Pokedex.Description: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.

Pokedex.Name: Haxorus
Pokedex.Description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

Pokedex.Name: Cubchoo
Pokedex.Description: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

Pokedex.Name: Beartic
Pokedex.Description: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

Pokedex.Name: Cryogonal
Pokedex.Description: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

Pokedex.Name: Shelmet
Pokedex.Description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

Pokedex.Name: Accelgor
Pokedex.Description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

Pokedex.Name: Stunfisk
Pokedex.Description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

Pokedex.Name: Galarian Stunfisk
Pokedex.Description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

Pokedex.Name: Mienfoo
Pokedex.Description: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Mienshao
Pokedex.Description: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

Pokedex.Name: Druddigon
Pokedex.Description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

Pokedex.Name: Golett
Pokedex.Description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

Pokedex.Name: Golurk
Pokedex.Description: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

Pokedex.Name: Pawniard
Pokedex.Description: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

Pokedex.Name: Bisharp
Pokedex.Description: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

Pokedex.Name: Bouffalant
Pokedex.Description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

Pokedex.Name: Rufflet
Pokedex.Description: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

Pokedex.Name: Braviary
Pokedex.Description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Braviary
Pokedex.Description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

Pokedex.Name: Vullaby
Pokedex.Description: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

Pokedex.Name: Mandibuzz
Pokedex.Description: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

Pokedex.Name: Heatmor
Pokedex.Description: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

Pokedex.Name: Durant
Pokedex.Description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

Pokedex.Name: Deino
Pokedex.Description: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

Pokedex.Name: Zweilous
Pokedex.Description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

Pokedex.Name: Hydreigon
Pokedex.Description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

Pokedex.Name: Larvesta
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

Pokedex.Name: Volcarona
Pokedex.Description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

Pokedex.Name: Cobalion
Pokedex.Description: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

Pokedex.Name: Terrakion
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

Pokedex.Name: Virizion
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

Pokedex.Name: Tornadus
Pokedex.Description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

Pokedex.Name: Tornadus Incarnate Forme
Pokedex.Description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

Pokedex.Name: Tornadus Therian Forme
Pokedex.Description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

Pokedex.Name: Thundurus
Pokedex.Description: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

Pokedex.Name: Thundurus Incarnate Forme
Pokedex.Description: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

Pokedex.Name: Thundurus Therian Forme
Pokedex.Description: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

Pokedex.Name: Reshiram
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

Pokedex.Name: Zekrom
Pokedex.Description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

Pokedex.Name: Landorus
Pokedex.Description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

Pokedex.Name: Landorus Incarnate Forme
Pokedex.Description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

Pokedex.Name: Landorus Therian Forme
Pokedex.Description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

Pokedex.Name: Kyurem
Pokedex.Description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

Pokedex.Name: Black Kyurem
Pokedex.Description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

Pokedex.Name: White Kyurem
Pokedex.Description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

Pokedex.Name: Keldeo
Pokedex.Description: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

Pokedex.Name: Keldeo Resolute Form
Pokedex.Description: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

Pokedex.Name: Meloetta
Pokedex.Description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

Pokedex.Name: Meloetta Aria Forme
Pokedex.Description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

Pokedex.Name: Meloetta Pirouette Forme
Pokedex.Description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

Pokedex.Name: Genesect
Pokedex.Description: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.

Pokedex.Name: Genesect Douse Drive
Pokedex.Description: Genesect assumes its flight configuration to soar through the sky. Its current form is equipped with a cassette loaded with water energy.

Pokedex.Name: Genesect Shock Drive
Pokedex.Description: Genesect fires off projectile energy blasts. Its current form is equipped with a cassette loaded with electric energy.

Pokedex.Name: Genesect Burn Drive
Pokedex.Description: Genesect possesses sharp steel claws. Its current form is equipped with a cassette loaded with fire energy.

Pokedex.Name: Genesect Chill Drive
Pokedex.Description: Genesect is devoid of mercy. Its current form is equipped with a cassette loaded with ice energy.

Pokedex.Name: Chespin
Pokedex.Description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

Pokedex.Name: Quilladin
Pokedex.Description: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

Pokedex.Name: Chesnaught
Pokedex.Description: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

Pokedex.Name: Fennekin
Pokedex.Description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

Pokedex.Name: Braixen
Pokedex.Description: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

Pokedex.Name: Delphox
Pokedex.Description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

Pokedex.Name: Froakie
Pokedex.Description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

Pokedex.Name: Frogadier
Pokedex.Description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

Pokedex.Name: Greninja
Pokedex.Description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

Pokedex.Name: Ash-Greninja
Pokedex.Description: Obtain from License Journey for 980 License Points

Pokedex.Name: Bunnelby
Pokedex.Description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

Pokedex.Name: Diggersby
Pokedex.Description: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

Pokedex.Name: Fletchling
Pokedex.Description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

Pokedex.Name: Fletchinder
Pokedex.Description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

Pokedex.Name: Talonflame
Pokedex.Description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

Pokedex.Name: Scatterbug
Pokedex.Description: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

Pokedex.Name: Spewpa
Pokedex.Description: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon
Pokedex.Description: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Archipelago Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from places with many islands.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Continental Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from lands of vast space.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Elegant Pattern
Pokedex.Description: Jungle/Marine/Modern/Ocean/Polar/Tundra Patterns

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Fancy Pattern
Pokedex.Description: have the Fancy Pattern, regardless of the set geographic location of the

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Garden Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from verdant lands.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon High Plains Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from lands with little rain.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Icy Snow Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from frigid lands.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Jungle Pattern

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Meadow Pattern

Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from sun-drenched lands.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Poké Ball Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from a special land.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Polar Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from snowy lands.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon River Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from lands where large rivers flow.

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Sandstorm Pattern

Pokedex.Name: Vivillon Tundra Pattern
Pokedex.Description: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from lands of severe cold.

Pokedex.Name: Litleo
Pokedex.Description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

Pokedex.Name: Pyroar
Pokedex.Description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

Pokedex.Name: Flabébé Red Flower
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden within blooming wild flowers. It is particularly fond of red flowers.

Pokedex.Name: Flabébé Yellow Flower
Pokedex.Description: This Flabébé rides a yellow flower. The Pokémon is defenseless and vulnerable before it has found and received power from a flower.

Pokedex.Name: Flabébé Orange Flower
Pokedex.Description: This Flabébé rides an orange flower. On its head, it wears a crown of pollen that has healing properties.

Pokedex.Name: Flabébé Blue Flower
Pokedex.Description: Once it finds a flower it likes, this Pokémon will spend the rest of its life taking care of its flower. This Flabébé rides a blue flower.

Pokedex.Name: Flabébé White Flower
Pokedex.Description: This Flabébé rides a white flower. The wind blows this Pokémon around as it drifts in search of flower gardens.

Pokedex.Name: Floette
Pokedex.Description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

Pokedex.Name: Floette Red Flower
Pokedex.Description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

Pokedex.Description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

Pokedex.Description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

Pokedex.Name: Florges
Pokedex.Description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

Pokedex.Description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

Pokedex.Name: Florges White Flower
Pokedex.Description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

Pokedex.Name: Skiddo
Pokedex.Description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

Pokedex.Name: Gogoat
Pokedex.Description: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

Pokedex.Name: Pancham
Pokedex.Description: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

Pokedex.Name: Pangoro
Pokedex.Description: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Furfrou
Pokedex.Description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

Pokedex.Name: Espurr
Pokedex.Description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

Pokedex.Name: Meowstic
Pokedex.Description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

Pokedex.Name: Meowstic♂
Pokedex.Description: Female Meowstic are more aggressive than males. Their expression remains blank even while they're wielding immense psychic power.

Pokedex.Name: Meowstic♀
Pokedex.Description: Female Meowstic are more aggressive than males. Their expression remains blank even while they're wielding immense psychic power.

Pokedex.Name: Honedge
Pokedex.Description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

Pokedex.Name: Doublade
Pokedex.Description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

Pokedex.Name: Aegislash
Pokedex.Description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Aegislash Shield Forme
Pokedex.Description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

Pokedex.Name: Aegislash Blade Forme
Pokedex.Description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

Pokedex.Name: Spritzee
Pokedex.Description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

Pokedex.Name: Aromatisse
Pokedex.Description: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

Pokedex.Name: Swirlix
Pokedex.Description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

Pokedex.Name: Slurpuff
Pokedex.Description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

Pokedex.Name: Inkay
Pokedex.Description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

Pokedex.Name: Malamar
Pokedex.Description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

Pokedex.Name: Binacle
Pokedex.Description: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

Pokedex.Name: Barbaracle
Pokedex.Description: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

Pokedex.Name: Skrelp
Pokedex.Description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

Pokedex.Name: Dragalge
Pokedex.Description: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

Pokedex.Name: Clauncher
Pokedex.Description: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

Pokedex.Name: Clawitzer
Pokedex.Description: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

Pokedex.Name: Helioptile
Pokedex.Description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

Pokedex.Name: Heliolisk
Pokedex.Description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

Pokedex.Name: Tyrunt
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

Pokedex.Name: Tyrantrum
Pokedex.Description: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

Pokedex.Name: Amaura
Pokedex.Description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

Pokedex.Name: Aurorus
Pokedex.Description: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

Pokedex.Name: Sylveon
Pokedex.Description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

Pokedex.Name: Hawlucha
Pokedex.Description: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

Pokedex.Name: Dedenne
Pokedex.Description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

Pokedex.Name: Carbink
Pokedex.Description: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

Pokedex.Name: Goomy
Pokedex.Description: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.

Pokedex.Name: Sliggoo
Pokedex.Description: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Sliggoo
Pokedex.Description: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

Pokedex.Name: Goodra
Pokedex.Description: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Goodra
Pokedex.Description: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

Pokedex.Name: Klefki
Pokedex.Description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

Pokedex.Name: Phantump
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

Pokedex.Name: Trevenant
Pokedex.Description: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

Pokedex.Name: Pumpkaboo
Pokedex.Description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

Pokedex.Name: Pumpkaboo Small Size
Pokedex.Description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

Pokedex.Name: Pumpkaboo Average Size

Pokedex.Name: Pumpkaboo Large Size
Pokedex.Description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

Pokedex.Name: Pumpkaboo Super Size
Pokedex.Description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

Pokedex.Name: Gourgeist
Pokedex.Description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

Pokedex.Name: Gourgeist Small Size
Pokedex.Description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
