Pokedex.Name: Gourgeist Super Size
Pokedex.Description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

Pokedex.Name: Bergmite
Pokedex.Description: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

Pokedex.Name: Avalugg
Pokedex.Description: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Avalugg
Pokedex.Description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

Pokedex.Name: Noibat
Pokedex.Description: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

Pokedex.Name: Noivern
Pokedex.Description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

Pokedex.Name: Xerneas
Pokedex.Description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

Pokedex.Name: Yveltal
Pokedex.Description: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

Pokedex.Name: Zygarde
Pokedex.Description: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

Pokedex.Name: Zygarde 50% Forme
Pokedex.Description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

Pokedex.Name: Zygarde 10% Forme
Pokedex.Description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

Pokedex.Name: Zygarde Complete Forme
Pokedex.Description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

Pokedex.Name: Diancie
Pokedex.Description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

Pokedex.Name: Mega Diancie
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Hoopa
Pokedex.Description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

Pokedex.Name: Hoopa Confined
Pokedex.Description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

Pokedex.Name: Hoopa Unbound
Pokedex.Description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

Pokedex.Name: Volcanion
Pokedex.Description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

Pokedex.Name: Rowlet
Pokedex.Description: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

Pokedex.Name: Dartrix
Pokedex.Description: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

Pokedex.Name: Decidueye
Pokedex.Description: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

Pokedex.Name: Hisuian Decidueye
Pokedex.Description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

Pokedex.Name: Litten
Pokedex.Description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

Pokedex.Name: Torracat
Pokedex.Description: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

Pokedex.Name: Incineroar
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.

Pokedex.Name: Popplio
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.

Pokedex.Name: Brionne
Pokedex.Description: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Primarina
Pokedex.Description: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

Pokedex.Name: Pikipek
Pokedex.Description: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

Pokedex.Name: Trumbeak
Pokedex.Description: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

Pokedex.Name: Toucannon
Pokedex.Description: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

Pokedex.Name: Yungoos
Pokedex.Description: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

Pokedex.Name: Gumshoos
Pokedex.Description: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.

Pokedex.Name: Grubbin
Pokedex.Description: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

Pokedex.Name: Charjabug
Pokedex.Description: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

Pokedex.Name: Vikavolt
Pokedex.Description: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Crabrawler
Pokedex.Description: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

Pokedex.Name: Crabominable
Pokedex.Description: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

Pokedex.Name: Oricorio
Pokedex.Description: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

Pokedex.Name: Oricorio Baile Style
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

Pokedex.Name: Oricorio Pom-Pom Style
Pokedex.Description: type. It creates electricity by rubbing its pom-poms together. Then it dances as it approaches its opponent before attacking. When it drinks different special

Pokedex.Name: Oricorio Pa'u Style
Pokedex.Description: and Flying type. By singing and dancing, its Psychic powers get stronger and stronger.

Pokedex.Name: Oricorio Sensu Style
Pokedex.Description: and Flying type. Oricorio display elegance and grace when they dance.

Pokedex.Name: Cutiefly
Pokedex.Description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

Pokedex.Name: Ribombee
Pokedex.Description: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

Pokedex.Name: Rockruff
Pokedex.Description: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

Pokedex.Name: Rockruff
Pokedex.Description: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

Pokedex.Name: Lycanroc
Pokedex.Description: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

Pokedex.Name: Lycanroc Midday Form
Pokedex.Description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

Pokedex.Name: Lycanroc Midnight Form
Pokedex.Description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

Pokedex.Name: Lycanroc Dusk Form
Pokedex.Description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

Pokedex.Name: Wishiwashi
Pokedex.Description: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Wishiwashi Solo Form
Pokedex.Description: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Wishiwashi School Form
Pokedex.Description: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Mareanie
Pokedex.Description: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

Pokedex.Name: Toxapex
Pokedex.Description: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

Pokedex.Name: Mudbray
Pokedex.Description: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

Pokedex.Name: Mudsdale
Pokedex.Description: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

Pokedex.Name: Dewpider
Pokedex.Description: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

Pokedex.Name: Araquanid
Pokedex.Description: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

Pokedex.Name: Fomantis
Pokedex.Description: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

Pokedex.Name: Lurantis
Pokedex.Description: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

Pokedex.Name: Morelull
Pokedex.Description: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

Pokedex.Name: Shiinotic
Pokedex.Description: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

Pokedex.Name: Salandit
Pokedex.Description: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

Pokedex.Name: Salazzle
Pokedex.Description: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

Pokedex.Name: Stufful
Pokedex.Description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

Pokedex.Name: Bewear
Pokedex.Description: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

Pokedex.Name: Bounsweet
Pokedex.Description: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

Pokedex.Name: Steenee
Pokedex.Description: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

Pokedex.Name: Tsareena
Pokedex.Description: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

Pokedex.Name: Comfey
Pokedex.Description: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

Pokedex.Name: Oranguru
Pokedex.Description: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.

Pokedex.Name: Passimian
Pokedex.Description: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

Pokedex.Name: Wimpod
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

Pokedex.Name: Golisopod
Pokedex.Description: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

Pokedex.Name: Sandygast
Pokedex.Description: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

Pokedex.Name: Palossand
Pokedex.Description: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

Pokedex.Name: Pyukumuku
Pokedex.Description: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

Pokedex.Name: Silvally
Pokedex.Description: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

Pokedex.Name: Minior
Pokedex.Description: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

Pokedex.Name: Minior Meteor Form
Pokedex.Description: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

Pokedex.Name: Minior Red Core

Pokedex.Name: Minior Violet Core
Pokedex.Description: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

Pokedex.Name: Komala
Pokedex.Description: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

Pokedex.Name: Turtonator
Pokedex.Description: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

Pokedex.Name: Togedemaru
Pokedex.Description: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

Pokedex.Name: Mimikyu
Pokedex.Description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

Pokedex.Name: Mimikyu Disguised Form
Pokedex.Description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

Pokedex.Name: Mimikyu Busted Form
Pokedex.Description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

Pokedex.Name: Bruxish
Pokedex.Description: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

Pokedex.Name: Drampa
Pokedex.Description: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

Pokedex.Name: Dhelmise
Pokedex.Description: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

Pokedex.Name: Jangmo-o
Pokedex.Description: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

Pokedex.Name: Hakamo-o
Pokedex.Description: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

Pokedex.Name: Kommo-o
Pokedex.Description: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

Pokedex.Name: Tapu Koko
Pokedex.Description: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

Pokedex.Name: Tapu Lele
Pokedex.Description: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

Pokedex.Name: Tapu Bulu
Pokedex.Description: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

Pokedex.Name: Tapu Fini
Pokedex.Description: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

Pokedex.Name: Cosmog
Pokedex.Description: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

Pokedex.Name: Cosmoem
Pokedex.Description: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

Pokedex.Name: Solgaleo
Pokedex.Description: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

Pokedex.Name: Lunala
Pokedex.Description: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

Pokedex.Name: Nihilego
Pokedex.Description: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

Pokedex.Name: Buzzwole
Pokedex.Description: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

Pokedex.Name: Pheromosa
Pokedex.Description: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

Pokedex.Name: Xurkitree
Pokedex.Description: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

Pokedex.Name: Celesteela
Pokedex.Description: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

Pokedex.Name: Kartana
Pokedex.Description: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

Pokedex.Name: Guzzlord
Pokedex.Description: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.

Pokedex.Name: Necrozma
Pokedex.Description: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

Pokedex.Name: Dusk Mane Necrozma
Pokedex.Description: a Necrozma and Lunala into Dawn Wings Necrozma.

Pokedex.Name: Dawn Wings Necrozma
Pokedex.Description: Necrozma has subjugated Lunala entirely, forcing the unfortunate

Pokedex.Name: Ultra Necrozma
Pokedex.Description: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

Pokedex.Name: Magearna
Pokedex.Description: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

Pokedex.Name: Magearna Original Color
Pokedex.Description: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

Pokedex.Name: Marshadow
Pokedex.Description: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

Pokedex.Name: Poipole
Pokedex.Description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

Pokedex.Name: Naganadel
Pokedex.Description: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

Pokedex.Name: Stakataka
Pokedex.Description: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

Pokedex.Name: Blacephalon
Pokedex.Description: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

Pokedex.Name: Zeraora
Pokedex.Description: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

Pokedex.Name: Meltan
Pokedex.Description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

Pokedex.Name: Melmetal
Pokedex.Description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Melmetal
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Grookey
Pokedex.Description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

Pokedex.Name: Thwackey
Pokedex.Description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

Pokedex.Name: Rillaboom
Pokedex.Description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Rillaboom
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Scorbunny
Pokedex.Description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

Pokedex.Name: Raboot
Pokedex.Description: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

Pokedex.Name: Cinderace
Pokedex.Description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Cinderace
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Sobble
Pokedex.Description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.

Pokedex.Name: Drizzile
Pokedex.Description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

Pokedex.Name: Inteleon
Pokedex.Description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Inteleon
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Skwovet
Pokedex.Description: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

Pokedex.Name: Greedent
Pokedex.Description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.

Pokedex.Name: Rookidee
Pokedex.Description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

Pokedex.Name: Corvisquire
Pokedex.Description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Corviknight
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Corviknight
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Blipbug
Pokedex.Description: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.

Pokedex.Name: Dottler
Pokedex.Description: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

Pokedex.Name: Orbeetle
Pokedex.Description: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Orbeetle
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Nickit
Pokedex.Description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

Pokedex.Name: Thievul
Pokedex.Description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

Pokedex.Name: Gossifleur
Pokedex.Description: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

Pokedex.Name: Eldegoss
Pokedex.Description: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

Pokedex.Name: Wooloo
Pokedex.Description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

Pokedex.Name: Dubwool
Pokedex.Description: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

Pokedex.Name: Chewtle
Pokedex.Description: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

Pokedex.Name: Drednaw
Pokedex.Description: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Drednaw
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Yamper
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

Pokedex.Name: Boltund
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

Pokedex.Name: Rolycoly
Pokedex.Description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

Pokedex.Name: Carkol
Pokedex.Description: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

Pokedex.Name: Coalossal
Pokedex.Description: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Coalossal
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Applin
Pokedex.Description: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.

Pokedex.Name: Flapple
Pokedex.Description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Flapple
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Appletun
Pokedex.Description: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Appletun
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Silicobra
Pokedex.Description: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

Pokedex.Name: Sandaconda
Pokedex.Description: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Sandaconda
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Cramorant
Pokedex.Description: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

Pokedex.Name: Cramorant Gulping Form
Pokedex.Description: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

Pokedex.Name: Cramorant Gorging Form
Pokedex.Description: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

Pokedex.Name: Arrokuda
Pokedex.Description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.

Pokedex.Name: Barraskewda
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

Pokedex.Name: Toxel
Pokedex.Description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

Pokedex.Name: Toxtricity
Pokedex.Description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

Pokedex.Name: Toxtricity Amped Form
Pokedex.Description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

Pokedex.Name: Toxtricity Low Key Form
Pokedex.Description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Toxtricity
Pokedex.Description: Out of control after its own poison penetrated its brain, it tears across the land in a rampage, contaminating the earth with toxic sweat.

Pokedex.Name: Sizzlipede
Pokedex.Description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

Pokedex.Name: Centiskorch
Pokedex.Description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Centiskorch
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Clobbopus
Pokedex.Description: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

Pokedex.Name: Grapploct
Pokedex.Description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

Pokedex.Name: Sinistea
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

Pokedex.Name: Polteageist
Pokedex.Description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

Pokedex.Name: Hatenna
Pokedex.Description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

Pokedex.Name: Hattrem
Pokedex.Description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

Pokedex.Name: Hatterene
Pokedex.Description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Hatterene
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Impidimp
Pokedex.Description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

Pokedex.Name: Morgrem
Pokedex.Description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

Pokedex.Name: Grimmsnarl
Pokedex.Description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Grimmsnarl
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Obstagoon
Pokedex.Description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

Pokedex.Name: Perrserker
Pokedex.Description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

Pokedex.Name: Cursola
Pokedex.Description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.

Pokedex.Name: Sirfetch'd
Pokedex.Description: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.

Pokedex.Name: Mr. Rime
Pokedex.Description: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

Pokedex.Name: Runerigus
Pokedex.Description: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

Pokedex.Description: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.

Pokedex.Name: Pincurchin
Pokedex.Description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

Pokedex.Name: Snom
Pokedex.Description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

Pokedex.Description: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.

Pokedex.Name: Stonjourner
Pokedex.Description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

Pokedex.Name: Eiscue

Pokedex.Name: Indeedee♂
Pokedex.Description: It dislikes conflict. If a fight occurs in its territory, it uses psychic power to throw things at the combatants in an effort to drive them away.

Pokedex.Name: Cufant
Pokedex.Description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

Pokedex.Name: Copperajah
Pokedex.Description: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Copperajah
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Dracozolt
Pokedex.Description: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

Pokedex.Name: Arctozolt
Pokedex.Description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

Pokedex.Name: Dracovish
Pokedex.Description: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

Pokedex.Name: Arctovish
Pokedex.Description: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

Pokedex.Name: Duraludon
Pokedex.Description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Duraludon
Pokedex.Description: Artwork on Bulbagarden Archives

Pokedex.Name: Dreepy
Pokedex.Description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

Pokedex.Name: Drakloak
Pokedex.Description: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

Pokedex.Name: Dragapult
Pokedex.Description: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

Pokedex.Name: Eternatus
Pokedex.Description: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

Pokedex.Name: Eternamax Eternatus
Pokedex.Description: 's meddling, Eternatus absorbed all the energy in the Galar region. It's now in a state of power overload.

Pokedex.Name: Kubfu
Pokedex.Description: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

Pokedex.Name: Urshifu
Pokedex.Description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Urshifu
Pokedex.Description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

Pokedex.Name: Gigantamax Urshifu
Pokedex.Description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

Pokedex.Name: Zarude
Pokedex.Description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

Pokedex.Name: Zarude Dada
Pokedex.Description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

Pokedex.Name: Regieleki
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.

Pokedex.Name: Regidrago
Pokedex.Description: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

Pokedex.Name: Glastrier
Pokedex.Description: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

Pokedex.Name: Spectrier
Pokedex.Description: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

Pokedex.Name: Calyrex
Pokedex.Description: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

Pokedex.Name: Ice Rider Calyrex
Pokedex.Description: A superscript level indicates that Calyrex can learn this move normally in Generation IX

Pokedex.Name: Shadow Rider Calyrex
Pokedex.Description: A superscript level indicates that Calyrex can learn this move normally in Generation IX

Pokedex.Name: Wyrdeer
Pokedex.Description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

Pokedex.Name: Kleavor
Pokedex.Description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

Pokedex.Name: Ursaluna
Pokedex.Description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

Pokedex.Name: Bloodmoon Ursaluna
Pokedex.Description: It crossed the sea and drifted ashore in a new land. Surviving in this place led it to take on a unique appearance and gain special powers.

Pokedex.Name: Basculegion
Pokedex.Description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

Pokedex.Name: Basculegion♂
Pokedex.Description: The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero (Violet)

Pokedex.Name: Basculegion♀
Pokedex.Description: The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero (Violet)

Pokedex.Name: Sneasler
Pokedex.Description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

Pokedex.Name: Overqwil
Pokedex.Description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

Pokedex.Name: Enamorus
Pokedex.Description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

Pokedex.Name: Enamorus Incarnate Forme
Pokedex.Description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

Pokedex.Name: Enamorus Therian Forme
Pokedex.Description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

Pokedex.Name: Sprigatito
Pokedex.Description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

Pokedex.Name: Floragato
Pokedex.Description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

Pokedex.Name: Meowscarada
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

Pokedex.Name: Fuecoco
Pokedex.Description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

Pokedex.Name: Crocalor
Pokedex.Description: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

Pokedex.Name: Skeledirge
Pokedex.Description: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

Pokedex.Name: Quaxly
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime."

Pokedex.Name: Quaxwell
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

Pokedex.Name: Quaquaval
Pokedex.Description: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

Pokedex.Name: Lechonk
Pokedex.Description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

Pokedex.Name: OOinkologne
Pokedex.Description: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

Pokedex.Name: OOinkologne♂
Pokedex.Description: type. It exudes a sweet, alluring scent from its tail, make it irresistable to female Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: OOinkologne♀
Pokedex.Description: type. It exudes a sweet, alluring scent from its tail, make it irresistable to female Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Tarountula
Pokedex.Description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

Pokedex.Name: Spidops
Pokedex.Description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

Pokedex.Name: Nymble
Pokedex.Description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

Pokedex.Name: Lokix
Pokedex.Description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

Pokedex.Name: Pawmi
Pokedex.Description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

Pokedex.Name: Pawmo
Pokedex.Description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

Pokedex.Name: Pawmot
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

Pokedex.Name: Tandemaus
Pokedex.Description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

Pokedex.Name: Maushold
Pokedex.Description: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

Pokedex.Name: Maushold Family of Three
Pokedex.Description: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

Pokedex.Name: Maushold Family of Four
Pokedex.Description: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

Pokedex.Name: Fidough
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

Pokedex.Name: Dachsbun
Pokedex.Description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

Pokedex.Name: Smoliv
Pokedex.Description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

Pokedex.Name: Dolliv
Pokedex.Description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

Pokedex.Name: Arboliva
Pokedex.Description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Squawkabilly
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

Pokedex.Name: Squawkabilly Green Plumage
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

Pokedex.Name: Squawkabilly Blue Plumage
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

Pokedex.Name: Squawkabilly Yellow Plumage
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

Pokedex.Name: Squawkabilly White Plumage
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

Pokedex.Name: Nacli
Pokedex.Description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

Pokedex.Name: Naclstack
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

Pokedex.Name: Garganacl
Pokedex.Description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

Pokedex.Name: Charcadet
Pokedex.Description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

Pokedex.Name: Armarouge
Pokedex.Description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

Pokedex.Name: Ceruledge
Pokedex.Description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

Pokedex.Name: Tadbulb
Pokedex.Description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

Pokedex.Name: Bellibolt
Pokedex.Description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

Pokedex.Name: Wattrel
Pokedex.Description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

Pokedex.Name: Kilowattrel
Pokedex.Description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

Pokedex.Name: Maschiff
Pokedex.Description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

Pokedex.Name: Mabosstiff
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

Pokedex.Name: Shroodle
Pokedex.Description: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

Pokedex.Name: Grafaiai
Pokedex.Description: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

Pokedex.Name: Bramblin
Pokedex.Description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Brambleghast
Pokedex.Description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

Pokedex.Name: Toedscool
Pokedex.Description: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

Pokedex.Name: Toedscruel
Pokedex.Description: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

Pokedex.Name: Klawf
Pokedex.Description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

Pokedex.Name: Capsakid
Pokedex.Description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

Pokedex.Name: Scovillain
Pokedex.Description: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

Pokedex.Name: Rellor
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

Pokedex.Name: Rabsca
Pokedex.Description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

Pokedex.Name: Flittle
Pokedex.Description: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

Pokedex.Name: Espathra
Pokedex.Description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

Pokedex.Name: Tinkatink
Pokedex.Description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

Pokedex.Name: Tinkatuff
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

Pokedex.Name: Tinkaton
Pokedex.Description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

Pokedex.Name: Wiglett
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

Pokedex.Name: Wugtrio
Pokedex.Description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

Pokedex.Name: Bombirdier
Pokedex.Description: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

Pokedex.Name: Finizen
Pokedex.Description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

Pokedex.Name: Palafin
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

Pokedex.Name: Palafin Zero Form
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

Pokedex.Name: Palafin Hero Form
Pokedex.Description: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

Pokedex.Name: Varoom
Pokedex.Description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

Pokedex.Name: Revavroom
Pokedex.Description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.

Pokedex.Name: Cyclizar
Pokedex.Description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

Pokedex.Name: Orthworm
Pokedex.Description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

Pokedex.Name: Glimmet
Pokedex.Description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

Pokedex.Name: Glimmora
Pokedex.Description: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

Pokedex.Name: Greavard
Pokedex.Description: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Houndstone
Pokedex.Description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

Pokedex.Name: Flamigo
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

Pokedex.Name: Cetoddle
Pokedex.Description: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

Pokedex.Name: Cetitan
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

Pokedex.Name: Veluza
Pokedex.Description: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

Pokedex.Name: Dondozo
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

Pokedex.Name: Tatsugiri
Pokedex.Description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

Pokedex.Name: Tatsugiri Curly Form
Pokedex.Description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

Pokedex.Name: Tatsugiri Droopy Form
Pokedex.Description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

Pokedex.Name: Tatsugiri Stretchy Form
Pokedex.Description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

Pokedex.Name: Annihilape
Pokedex.Description: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

Pokedex.Name: Clodsire
Pokedex.Description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

Pokedex.Name: Farigiraf
Pokedex.Description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

Pokedex.Name: Dudunsparce
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

Pokedex.Name: Dudunsparce Two-Segment Form
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

Pokedex.Name: Dudunsparce Three-Segment Form
Pokedex.Description: The gentle Dudunsparce will put Pokémon that wander into its nest onto its back and carry them to the entrance.

Pokedex.Name: Kingambit
Pokedex.Description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

Pokedex.Name: Great Tusk
Pokedex.Description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

Pokedex.Name: Scream Tail
Pokedex.Description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

Pokedex.Name: Brute Bonnet
Pokedex.Description: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Flutter Mane
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

Pokedex.Name: Slither Wing
Pokedex.Description: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

Pokedex.Name: Sandy Shocks
Pokedex.Description: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Treads
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Bundle
Pokedex.Description: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Hands
Pokedex.Description: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Jugulis
Pokedex.Description: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Moth
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Thorns
Pokedex.Description: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

Pokedex.Name: Frigibax
Pokedex.Description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

Pokedex.Name: Arctibax
Pokedex.Description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

Pokedex.Name: Baxcalibur
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

Pokedex.Name: Gimmighoul Chest Form
Pokedex.Description: Side Mission 122: "Let's Golden Goooooo!"

Pokedex.Name: Gimmighoul Roaming Form
Pokedex.Description: Side Mission 122: "Let's Golden Goooooo!"

Pokedex.Name: Gholdengo
Pokedex.Description: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

Pokedex.Name: Wo-Chien
Pokedex.Description: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Chien-Pao
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

Pokedex.Name: Ting-Lu
Pokedex.Description: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Chi-Yu
Pokedex.Description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

Pokedex.Name: Roaring Moon
Pokedex.Description: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Valiant
Pokedex.Description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

Pokedex.Name: Koraidon
Pokedex.Description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

Pokedex.Name: Miraidon
Pokedex.Description: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

Pokedex.Name: Walking Wake
Pokedex.Description: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Leaves
Pokedex.Description: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.

Pokedex.Name: Dipplin
Pokedex.Description: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

Pokedex.Name: Poltchageist Counterfeit Form
Pokedex.Description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Poltchageist Artisan Form
Pokedex.Description: It sprinkles some of its powdery body onto food and drains the life-force from those who so much as lick it.

Pokedex.Name: Sinistcha
Pokedex.Description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

Pokedex.Name: Sinistcha Unremarkable Form
Pokedex.Description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

Pokedex.Name: Sinistcha Masterpiece Form
Pokedex.Description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

Pokedex.Name: Okidogi
Pokedex.Description: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

Pokedex.Name: Munkidori
Pokedex.Description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

Pokedex.Name: Fezandipiti
Pokedex.Description: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

Pokedex.Name: Ogerpon
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

Pokedex.Name: Ogerpon Teal Mask
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

Pokedex.Name: Ogerpon Wellspring Mask
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

Pokedex.Name: Ogerpon Hearthflame Mask
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

Pokedex.Name: Ogerpon Cornerstone Mask
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

Pokedex.Name: Ogerpon Terastal Form
Pokedex.Description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

Pokedex.Name: Archaludon
Pokedex.Description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

Pokedex.Name: Hydrapple
Pokedex.Description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

Pokedex.Name: Gouging Fire
Pokedex.Description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

Pokedex.Name: Raging Bolt
Pokedex.Description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Boulder
Pokedex.Description: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

Pokedex.Name: Iron Crown
Pokedex.Description: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.

Pokedex.Name: Terapagos
Pokedex.Description: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

Pokedex.Name: Terapagos Normal Form
Pokedex.Description: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
